command.$interpolate: capcli ping ask {{principal}} "Fraud score 0.83 on ORD-1042. Approve dispatch?" --options approve,deny --timeout 60m --intent "fraud gate above dispatch threshold requires human sign-off"
command.$example: capcli ping ask user:root "Fraud score 0.83 on ORD-1042. Approve dispatch?" --options approve,deny --timeout 60m --intent "fraud gate above dispatch threshold requires human sign-off"

culprit.$interpolate: inquiry ask_88a issued to {{principal}}; {{frame_id}} suspended pending human choice — checkpoint and OCC state_fences persisted to _pending_asks; exit 6 is a checkpoint, not an error
culprit.$example: inquiry ask_88a issued to user:root; frame_026 suspended pending human choice — checkpoint and OCC state_fences persisted to _pending_asks; exit 6 is a checkpoint, not an error

component.remedy: resolve via 'capcli ping resolve ask_88a --choice approve' (ask predicate re-evaluated against fresh reads; frame auto-resumes after hash re-verification), '--choice deny' to close the inquiry without dispatch, Cockpit one-click at http://127.0.0.1:4040/ask/ask_88a, or let the 60m inquiry expire fail-closed
